description: This PHP source file defines the FilterRepository class, which handles parsing filter parameters from HTTP requests and converting them into internal representations for the SuiteCRM JSON API. It also provides a method to generate a SuiteBeanResource.

classes.name: FilterRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling filter parsing and resource creation within the SuiteCRM JSON API.

methods.name: fromRequest
methods.description: Parses filter parameters from an HTTP request and returns an array of filter criteria.

methods.name: toSuiteBeanResource
methods.description: Creates and returns a SuiteBeanResource object using the current container.
